description: Zones inondables - hauteur d'eau en mètre - PAPI BSA scénario global 3 à 50 ans - T100 Q10 is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by BUREAU DE RECHERCHES GÉOLOGIQUES ET MINIÈRES. Flood zones - water height in meters - as part of the modelling of the global scenario 3 to 50 years PAPI BSA - Hydroclimatic scenario (Maritime M100 - River flow Q10). Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Flood zones - water height in meters - PAPI BSA global scenario 3 to 50 years - T100 Q10" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include tempête, crue, inondation, modélisation, changement climatique, lutte contre les inondations. The listing shows 2015-10-30 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
